basic_profile.name: Shivam S.
basic_profile.summary:
As a Back End Developer at Fello, I utilize my technical leadership and architecture skills to design and implement scalable and robust solutions for the company's investment and personal finance platform. With over a year of experience at Fello. Previously at 1K, I specialized in server-side applications, particularly in facilitating kirana shop owners experience via the Retailer app.
I graduated from the Indian Institute of Technology, Guwahati, with a Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering in 2018. My skill set includes coding standards, back-end development, web development, and cloud computing. Core competencies such as problem-solving, collaboration, communication, and creativity drive my work.
